id: # LoRA pilot (2026-11-18): a training set for a character LoRA, made with ComfyQ's own cards. One portrait of an invented designer from words, then the same person in other poses, framings, places, clothes and light from three editors (FLUX.3 Klein distilled, Qwen Image 2.1, MiniMax-H3-Image), every one chained from the portrait so the face does not drift edit after edit. Runs keep runtime.json; this suite is not seeded as examples.

caption: The character from words.
prompt: A natural photograph, half-body portrait of a woman in her early thirties standing in a bright design studio, facing the camera with a calm slight smile. She has a short asymmetric copper-red bob, longer on the left side, a light dusting of freckles across her nose and cheeks, green-grey eyes, and she wears round tortoiseshell glasses. She wears a mustard-yellow canvas work jacket over a plain black crew-neck t-shirt. Soft window light from the left, a blurred background of shelves with foam models and sketches, 85 mm lens, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture.
